To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the innovation system approach is suitable for analyzing AM technologies and their embedding in animal production.

the generation, development, use and diffusion of AM technologies in animal production in Germany are characterized by a complex and interlocked innovation system, which requires a systemic approach for innovation policies.
the development, implementation and application of animal monitoring technologies are embedded in an innovation system of heterogeneous actors and their interactions.
In summary, our research is concerned with
innovation in the animal production sector, which is a sector of the agricultural sector.
the question how innovation systems can be designed to support the generation, development, and use of AM innovations.
the question of how the innovation system in animal production can be strengthened to foster innovations in AM.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
AM is not only a technology issue but a system issue.
the innovation system approach can be used as an appropriate tool to analyse the complexity of AM technologies and their development in animal production.
AM technologies are a potential for innovation in German animal production and that the innovation system of AM is in a phase of transition towards a more mature innovation system.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the German innovation system for AM technologies is still at an early stage of development.
the development of AM technologies and their application in animal production is not an easy task.
the innovation system approach is a promising tool to analyse innovation processes and to develop strategies for innovation policy.
The main takeaway from our work is that
innovation policies should be able to respond to the identified needs of the innovation system.
the development of AM technologies is not only a matter of technological innovation, but also a question of innovation in the animal production sector.
innovation policy needs to be adapted to the needs of the sector and the actors involved in the innovation process.
